weekly.pricing_source: model list of connection {connection}, read by the weekly model check on {date}

reasons.better: ranks higher on the role's benchmark
reasons.non_inferior: cheaper and not worse on the role's benchmark beyond the margin
reasons.newer: a newer version of the same family on the same connection, with probe capabilities at least the current pick's (no benchmark data)
reasons.link_class: its link class or reach differs from the pick it would replace
reasons.privacy: its connection's data policy differs from the current one (it could be weaker)
reasons.host: its connection has a host the owner has not approved
reasons.connection: its connection is switched off, not a provider, or not in the preset's class order for the role
reasons.link: the link judge refuses it for the role
reasons.unlisted: the connection's model list does not show it
reasons.no_probe: it has no probe record for the version the model list shows
reasons.probe_unmet: its probe record does not meet the role's requirements
reasons.stale: its probe record is older than stale_catalog_days
reasons.worse: it ranks lower on the role's benchmark
reasons.not_newer: no benchmark data, and it is not a newer version of the same family with capabilities at least the current pick's
reasons.fetch_failed: the connection's model list could not be read
reasons.no_list: the connection has no model list (no wire shape)
reasons.no_grant: a custom preset with no model_check grant in force
reasons.setting_off: the owner setting for built-in presets is off
reasons.not_in_catalog: the model list shows a model the connections catalog does not list (never a candidate)
